channel.title: Blockfront
channel.description: Blockfront reports crypto news: Bitcoin and Ethereum, DeFi protocols, exchanges, regulation, security incidents, funding rounds and network upgrades.

item.title: Binance secures $6.5 billion freeze after crypto theft
item.description: Binance says an Abu Dhabi court issued a worldwide $6.5 billion freeze tied to its October hack, while separate orders give partners a legal route to return assets.

item.title: What happens during a transfer: Ethereum locks, Gnosis mints
item.description: What happens during a Gnosis Bridge transfer? Ethereum USDC is locked, validators attest to an AMB message, and Gnosis Chain mints tokens to the recipient.

item.title: US Gets Court Approval to Seize $1.2B in Binance Theft
item.description: The Justice Department says courts authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion from the Binance hack, as efforts to trace and freeze the stolen assets continue.

item.title: How to add Fraxtal to MetaMask when it is missing
item.description: How to add Fraxtal network to MetaMask with chain ID 252 and the official RPC, then verify your selected wallet balance against Fraxscan before using Fraxswap.

item.title: Transfer tax before swapping: How to check a token
item.description: To check if a token has a transfer tax before swapping, inspect its contract and simulate the exact trade to estimate the amount you’ll receive before signing.

item.title: How to reduce TeleSwap risks and bridge without losing funds
item.description: TeleSwap risks and how to reduce them: use the official app, match the network and recipient, test with a small deposit, then revoke approvals and verify teleBTC.

item.title: US wins court authority over $1.2bn in stolen Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says court orders cover more than $1.2 billion of Binance’s stolen crypto, within $2.7 billion frozen as tracing efforts continue.

item.title: How to swap fee-on-transfer tokens after a revert
item.description: How to swap fee on transfer tokens without failing: set slippage above the trade's tax, stay under token caps, then refresh the quote and retry.

item.title: sBTC vs tBTC: where each bitcoin sits
item.description: sBTC vs tBTC comes down to custody: tBTC spreads BTC across rotating threshold wallets, while sBTC relies on one peg wallet controlled by Stacks signers.

item.title: Ethereum Swaps: What Happens Before Inclusion
item.description: How does the Ethereum public mempool work? Each node keeps and shares its own pool of valid pending transactions; builders choose transactions for blocks.

item.title: What does “settled” mean in CoW Explorer: Your order executed
item.description: What does settled mean in CoW Explorer? It means your order was executed on-chain; compare requested and executed amounts to see how much traded.

item.title: How do you find a completed token swap in CoW Explorer?
item.description: Find a completed token swap in CoW Explorer by searching its network for an order ID or wallet address, then confirm Filled and inspect execution amounts and settlement.

item.title: US authorizes seizure of $1.2 billion in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department says courts authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion from Binance’s October theft, while recovery work continues.

item.title: cbridge wallet not connecting: Fix the wallet handshake
item.description: cBridge wallet not connecting? Resolve extension clashes, hidden approvals, stale sessions or unsupported networks, then reconnect and confirm your address appears.

item.title: US court authorizes action on $1.2bn in stolen Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says courts authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion from Binance’s $6 billion October theft; tracing and recovery continue.

item.title: Is Jumper bridge safe for a first transfer?
item.description: Is Jumper bridge safe? Broadly usable, but each transfer carries LI.FI contract risk and the selected bridge’s risk. Limit approvals and test with a small amount.

item.title: US wins court authority over $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department has court authority over more than $1.2 billion of crypto stolen from Binance, part of $2.7 billion frozen as recovery efforts continue.

item.title: US secures authority to seize $1.2 billion in Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department secured court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion stolen from Binance; efforts to trace and freeze the remaining funds continue.

item.title: US moves to seize $1.2 billion in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department says court-authorized action covers more than $1.2 billion of Binance funds, part of $2.7 billion frozen after an October theft.

item.title: US courts authorize seizure of $1.2 billion in Binance hack crypto
